name: Mia Holt
car: 2012 Honda Civic, silver, WA BKR-2187 (returned to family)
findings: Quiet and meticulous. University of Washington Tacoma, Mathematics & Statistics, 2017. Volunteered on weekends at the Second Chance animal shelter.
Instagram: coffee at work, the shelter, sunsets over the bay. Last post 2019-11-02: a dark office window at night, caption "Numbers don't lie. People do."
News 2019: "Missing analyst searched for near North Bridge", "Search for Mia Holt called off".
Second Chance shelter: 2018 thank-you post to volunteers, Mia is on the list.
Google Photos: a dog photo with no name, caption "My best friend ❤️".

name: Jake Holt
car: 2016 Ford F-150, dark blue, WA JKH-4410
findings: Mia's younger brother. Writes to WHOAMI on a closed forum. Great with cars, bad with computers.
Blog "7 years without Mia": one post every November 8. Latest (2025): "I still check her page."
"Find Mia" group: old posts thanking Owen for his help "analyzing the phone data".
Pine Auto Repair reviews: "Jake fixed everything in one day."

name: Linda Holt
job: School librarian, East Ridge High School
findings: Signed an NDA with Daniel Kerr in exchange for "family support" after Mia disappeared. Still regrets it.
Facebook post, 2018: "Today we lost our Biscuit. He was with us since 2011. Mia has been crying all evening…" (password clue)
Posts every March 14, Mia's birthday.
Photos from the school book fair.

name: Richard Holt
findings: Divorced Linda in 2009 and moved to Idaho. Rarely in touch with the kids.
His only comment under the missing-person post: "I'm sorry."

name: Ethan Brooks
job: 2019: bartender, The Rusty Anchor. 2026: bar manager, same place
findings: Dated Mia for a year and a half. Lied to the police that he was home that night.
Craigslist 2020: sold his Dodge Charger in a hurry, "need cash". Hint at debts.
WhatsApp group "Tacoma Aces": 23:30 photo from Mark, Ethan is in the shot. Alibi.
Comment under Sam Wright's video: "You don't know anything."
spoiler: Not the killer. Was hiding gambling debts and an underground poker game.

name: Daniel Kerr
job: 2019: CEO, Veridia Health. 2026: "startup advisor", Kerr Advisory
car: 2019 Tesla Model S, black, WA DKR-0001
findings: Founder of Veridia. Charismatic, loves talking about the company's "mission". Deleted Mia's work email the morning after and paid her family.
News 2022: "Veridia Health files for bankruptcy. Investors sue founder."
LinkedIn: "Sometimes a startup is 99 failures and one truth." Liked by ex-employees, except Kyle Bennett.
Dinner with investors 2019-11-08 on Melissa's Instagram and Salt & Cedar's page. Alibi.
Plate DKR-0001 — yes, he paid for it.
spoiler: Not the killer. Faked user metrics for investors.

name: Melissa Kerr
findings: Instagram post 2019-11-08 22:47: table at Salt & Cedar, "Evening with the best people. Go Veridia!" Daniel is in the photo. Confirms his alibi.
Lots of photos of their home interior — clearly beyond a startup's means.

name: Walter Green
findings: Grumpy loner. Neighbors think he's creepy because of the camera in his window. Was rude to police in 2019 and quickly let go.
Website "Window on Linden St": 24/7 weather and bird stream, archive by date. Recording of 2019-11-08 is key evidence.
Letter to city council, 2018: complaint about cars at night on Linden St.
Birdwatchers forum: proud of a "rare waxwing" photo, 2020.
Complaint about him from Dorothy Shaw to the property manager.

name: Owen Lind
job: 2019: Head of IT & Security, Veridia Health. 2026: security consultant, Cascade Secure
findings: Friendly, "one of the guys", fixed everyone's laptops. Runs trails on weekends. In 2020 the city gave him an award for helping search for Mia Holt.
Strava @owenruns: dozens of runs, including at Stonehill Quarry — so the 2019-11-08 "walk" there doesn't look strange until you check the time (23:14).
Steam "0wl": shown online all night on 2019-11-08, but the activity log has a gap 22:00–00:40.
Lime: ride 00:04–00:31 from North Bridge to Hillcrest.
Craigslist 2025: "Selling gaming monitor", number (253) 555-0187.
News 2020: photo with the mayor and the award.
"Find Mia" group: the most active member, posts "the map of the phone's last location".

name: Carol Lind

social.handle: posts garden photos and her son

findings: Doesn't know a company is registered in her name and at her address. Her son "asked her to sign some tax papers".
Business registry: OL Data Consulting LLC, owner Carol Lind, 880 Orchard Way.
Facebook, 2019: "My Owen is helping the police again! So proud!"

name: Rachel Moore
findings: Mia's email of 2019-11-08 and her reply "Let's meet on Monday".
Her 2022 article on Veridia's bankruptcy — she never connected it to Mia.
X, 2019-11-11: "Source didn't show up. It happens."

name: Priya Natarajan
role: Mia's coworker and friend at Veridia
findings: Sat next to Mia. In Slack on 2019-11-05 Mia wrote to her: "I found something really bad in the data. Can't say yet."
Anniversary post: "She was always the last to leave. I still think I should have stayed with her that night."

name: Kyle Bennett
findings: Left Veridia in October 2019. LinkedIn: "Left because I disagreed with how the company counts its users." Hint at Kerr's fake metrics.
If contacted, replies: "Ask Dan where Bloom got a million active users."

name: Greg Holloway
findings: Listed as "buyer contact" in the spreadsheet from Mia's archive.
LinkedIn: "Data is the new oil."

name: Sandra Reyes
role: Detective who led the case in 2019
findings: Her notes in the police archive: "Neighbor across the street with a camera — check recordings?" marked "no time, case reassigned".
News 2023: retirement party, photo with a cake.

name: Brian Tate
findings: Report 2019-11-09 07:20: car at the bridge, doors unlocked, keys in the ignition, driver's seat pushed far back. Nobody noticed — Mia was 5'3".

name: Mark Dellinger
findings: Photo in "Tacoma Aces" 2019-11-08 23:30: table, cards, Ethan in the shot. Ethan's alibi.

name: Tony Russo
findings: Message to Ethan, 2019: "End of the month, bro. I'm not joking." Explains why Ethan lied.

name: Dorothy Shaw
findings: Statement 2019: "Around ten someone went up the stairs. Heavy steps, not hers." Written down, never followed up.
Complaint about Walter Green: "watches me from his window".

name: Gary Olsen
findings: Craigslist, December 2019: "Apt 3B on Linden St for rent, freshly renovated." Mia's apartment was rented out a month later.

name: Chloe Martin
findings: Every March 14 posts a school photo with Mia: two girls in braces at 2013 graduation.

name: Sam Wright
findings: Video 2021 "What happened to Mia Holt?": 50 minutes of theories, almost all wrong. Nearly accuses Ethan. Mentions cameras on Linden St without realizing it matters.
Comment from Ethan Brooks: "You don't know anything."

name: Heather Klein
findings: Nextdoor post 2019-11-09: "Someone was driving around the quarry again last night. Around 11pm a car was parked with its lights off. Teenagers?"

name: Jamal Williams
findings: Lime maintenance log 2019-11-09: "Scooter #4471 left in Hillcrest outside parking zone, moved." The same scooter.

name: Nick Kowalski
findings: Craigslist chat 2025 with (253) 555-0187: "Ok, I'll pick it up Saturday. Ridgeback Ct, 34?" — "Yes, call when you're here. Owen."

name: Trevor Nguyen
findings: Steam chat 2019-11-08 22:31: "wanna play?" — Owen doesn't answer until 00:52: "sorry, fell asleep". His status was "online" the whole time.

name: Liam O'Connor
findings: Covered for Ethan on 2019-11-08. Jokes in chat: "Off to his aces again, I'm working for two."

name: Betty Alvarez
role: Owner of the café near Veridia
findings: Mia's 2019 review: "Best flat white in town. Betty, you're a miracle."
Veridia staff often checked in here: you can see who had lunch with whom.

name: Margaret Hughes
findings: Lost cat posters for "Pumpkin" (2019) all over the neighborhood. Not related to the case.

name: Andy Flores
findings: "Find Mia" group member, searched by boat near the bridge. Wrote in 2019: "Weird nobody saw her at the bridge. There's always someone fishing there."

name: Olivia Chen
findings: Drew the "Have you seen Mia?" poster for the 2019 search. It's still pinned on her page.

name: Robert Douglas
findings: Statement 2019: fished at the bridge until midnight. Saw a car pull into the lot and "someone tall got out and walked toward the road, no flashlight". Police assumed it was Mia.
